title: Arithmetic calculations measured by intracranial EEG in the human brain
description: Intracranial stereo-EEG (SEEG) recordings from 20 adult patients performing arithmetic calculations. The deposit contains source-preprocessed data: low-pass filtered, downsampled to 512 Hz, bipolar re-referenced and epoched around the first operand. Trials are concatenated per subject into BrainVision files, and electrode coordinates are given in MNI space. It supports study of the temporal order of cortical activations and interactions during mental arithmetic.
methods_description: Data were acquired at 2048 Hz with DIXI SEEG electrodes and a Natus Quantum system. They were then low-pass filtered, downsampled to 512 Hz, bipolar re-referenced and epoched around the first operand by the original authors. Trials were concatenated back-to-back along time per subject for BIDS storage.
